tools.name: sfx
tools.description: Generate a sound effect from a text prompt using a local Stable Audio model (sa3.cpp). No API key, no Python. Returns the path to a WAV file. Use for foley and SFX: "metal impact with a deep sub boom", "whoosh across the screen", "footsteps on gravel". Keep prompts to one sound each and layer clips for complex scenes. Set notify_on to make the clip the sound played when that event happens (error: a tool call or test run failed, permission: waiting on the user, done: reply finished, abort: user interrupted, compact: context compacted); notify clips default to 2s.
